patterns.desc: authoritative delivery status enum
COLLECTED = 3 (clients must match; partner was off-by-one)
DELIVERED = 4
global switch gating bookDelivery creation
db.bookDelivery is bound to the hyphenated book-delivery collection
the immediate-assignment path adds maxETA with NO fallback - a missing or non-numeric value is a silent no-op, so expectedDeliveryAt comes out equal to pickupTime rather than invalid
the pending path's || 30 fallback rescues null/undefined/empty maxETA but not a non-numeric string - the asymmetry with the immediate path is the point
business day crosses midnight; every slot is stored under the STARTING date
single per-weekday resolver; iterating the flat timeSlots over-books every weekday
the one correct business-day window ([D 09:00, D+1 02:00]); feeds the paid guarantee
dispatch requires a STRICT isActive === true on an area - {$ne: false} is a different, wrong set
the code default is OFF but production's delivery-config doc sets it true - the scored path, not assignBestDeliveryDriver, is what actually runs (CORE.md invariant 10)
the single branch deciding pending-vs-immediate; with the prod flag on the left side is always true, so every order takes the scored path
in-flight includes "5" WAITING_IN_STORE - dropping it makes a driver holding orders inside a store score as fully idle (CORE.md invariant 11)
blank/0/null maxOrdersByAdmin returns 0 = SWITCHED OFF (product decision 2026-08-23, reverses the earlier "blank means no cap"); a stored 1 is raised to 2; role admin is exempt
extrapolates past the top orderPenalties rung; a Math.min(count,4) clamp makes the 5th order onward free and load stops mattering
the pending tick runs SEQUENTIALLY so each assignment sees the previous one's status:1 write; Promise.allSettled here re-creates the burst pile-up
availability and dispatch share one in-flight list - they drifted apart once already
only "3" COLLECTED_FROM_RESTAURANT means the courier has the food; "5" WAITING_IN_STORE is a PRE-pickup state (CORE.md invariant 11)
a courier still holding an uncollected pickup is stalled, not busy - handing him a second store makes both late (49.3% of production assignments did this)
the 2-order cap is a sort TIER not a filter - emptying the candidate list strands the order because the immediate engine has no pending row to retry from
the effective ceiling is the LOWER of the platform cap and maxOrdersByAdmin - 28 of 238 drivers are set above 2 and must NOT get a 3rd order out of it (CORE.md invariant 11)
in a shortage the scored engine ranks the over-cap group by activeOrderCount, not score - on score alone the closest courier collects every overflow order
same shortage rule in the immediate engine: past the cap, total load outranks pickup progress
the ONE place pickup is recorded; delivery status "3" is written alongside it and nowhere else stamps it
the switched-off test, applied at the eligibility stage - expressing it as zero capacity lets the engines' "nobody left, take everybody" fallback resurrect him (CORE.md invariant 11)
a stored courier limit of 1 is raised to 2 - one order is not worth dispatching a courier for on its own
the order limit is an off-switch, so it must only be written when the caller sent it; unconditional writes turned the driver-app profile save into a self-deactivation
driver client copy of delivery status enum
the only mobile driver-picker posts to the company-admin reassign endpoint
twin pairs collapse into TwinOrderCard unless mode is split
partner delivery status must match server (fixed off-by-one)
